title: South Korea KFTC alleges Google abused Android app dominance via GVP exclusivity contracts; potential fine ~849B won (~$615M)
summary: Korea's Fair Trade Commission (KFTC) on July 1 formally alleged Google abused its dominant Android app market position by signing exclusivity-style GVP (Project Hug) contracts with 22 top game companies — incl. Activision Blizzard King, Riot Games — over 6.75 years to prevent them from leaving Google Play. Affected revenue ~$9.2B. Max fine could reach ~849B won (~$615M), or 6% of relevant revenue.
why: 谷歌(GOOGL)继欧盟DMA令后再遭韩国重磅监管指控，多国反垄断压力叠加或影响AI广告/分发生态估值，持GOOGL仓位需关注监管折价风险。

title: Bitcoin slides toward $58,000: June ETF outflows hit record $4.06B — largest monthly outflow in spot ETF history
summary: Bitcoin fell ~2% to ~$58,690 on July 1 as quarter-end pressure combined with record spot ETF outflows. US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $4.06 billion in net outflows in June, the largest monthly outflow since the products launched. K33 notes 5-day net ETF flows were -34,267 BTC, the second-largest such stretch on record. Analysts warn no clear bottom yet confirmed.
why: 加密市场持续走弱是风险偏好收缩信号；Circle(CRCL)稳定币叙事赖以支撑的加密热度正在降温，同时BTC ETF流出规模创纪录也提示宏观避险情绪升温。

title: Tencent ramps up buybacks as share rout wipes out $309 billion: June repurchases top HK$9B — record monthly high for 2026
summary: Bloomberg reported June 30 that Tencent spent over HK$9 billion (~US$1.1B) on buybacks in June — set to be its largest monthly repurchase total in 2026 — buying back shares nearly every trading day since mid-May. Shareholders approved repurchase of up to ~912 million shares (10% of total) at May AGM. Shares have fallen ~$309B in market cap since October peak.
why: 腾讯大规模回购是EPS利好信号（10%股本回购授权），但$3090亿市值缩水凸显近期港股科技整体下行压力；对covered call策略需要重新评估行权价，sell put需提高审慎。

title: 美团发布万亿参数大模型LongCat-2.0：1.6万亿参数，业界首个全程国产算力（5万卡集群）完成训练
summary: 美团于6月30日开源LongCat-2.0，总参数1.6万亿（MoE架构，平均激活约48B），预训练数据逾30万亿token，原生支持100万token超长上下文；全程由国产AI芯片（5万卡集群）训练——中国大模型国产算力自主化里程碑。在OpenRouter实时调用量全球前三，专为Agentic Coding任务优化。
why: 美团(3690.HK)AI自研能力突破标志其摆脱Nvidia GPU依赖，可能大幅降低长期推理成本；开源策略也有助于扩大生态影响力，是Tech持仓中的估值催化剂。

title: SanDisk (SNDK) jumps 11% July 1 as Bernstein raises target to $3,000 (+76%); NAND long-term contracts reshape supercycle thesis
summary: Bernstein raised SanDisk (SNDK) price target from $1,700 to $3,000 (June 30), maintaining Outperform. Thesis: structural shift to long-term NAND supply agreements (LTAs) with fixed/range-bound pricing, with ~$42B contracted through 2028. Base-case FY2027 EPS estimate $243. SNDK surged 11% on July 1, adding to its ~490% YTD gain — best performer in S&P 500 in 2026.
why: 闪迪(SNDK)Bernstein升目标价至$3000代表市场首次将LTA固定定价结构纳入估值，显著降低了NAND周期性下行风险；对持有SNDK或存储赛道的投资者是重要估值锚，sell put策略隐含波动率也可能因此收窄。

title: 欧盟7月1日起正式取消150欧元以下跨境包裹免税，Temu欧洲本土备货仅约20%、面临成本骤升挑战
summary: 欧盟自2026年7月1日起正式取消150欧元以下跨境电商包裹免税政策（此前为de minimis exemption）。Temu欧洲本土备货比例仅约20%（远低于应对目标），物流模式已从空运（占比85%→2%）切换为船运以压缩关税成本至3-5%。拼多多(PDD)2025年净利润同比下降12%，Temu欧洲增速承压。
why: 欧盟免税取消是拼多多(PDD)面临的重大政策转折点，可能进一步压制2026年下半年Temu欧洲GMV增速；建议在业绩指引明朗前对PDD期权策略保持审慎，尤其避免短期裸卖put。
